facts.fact: 约旦三面间谍（一名医生）在爆炸中第一个死亡。
facts.anchor: The Jordanian triple agent, a medical doctor, died first

facts.fact: 两名军官（前特种部队士兵与前海豹队员）站得离他最近。
facts.anchor: Two officers, one a former Special Forces soldier and the other a former Navy SEAL, were standing closest to him

facts.fact: 基地负责人（三个孩子的母亲）面部与躯干直接中弹。
facts.anchor: The Chief of Base, a mother of three, took ball bearings directly in the face and torso

facts.fact: 她捧着的柠檬海绵生日蛋糕被汽化。
facts.anchor: The lemon sponge birthday cake she was carrying was vaporized

facts.fact: Subaru 的阿富汗司机被误认为恐怖分子的美军士兵射杀。
facts.anchor: the Afghan driver of the Subaru, shot by a U.S. soldier who mistook him for a terrorist

facts.fact: 未具名官员把反间谍失误的责任推给基地负责人。
facts.anchor: blame for the counterintelligence screwup was pinned on the Chief of Base

facts.fact: 站长 ARISTOTLE 被立即免职、召回并降级。
facts.anchor: ARISTOTLE, the Chief of Station, was immediately removed from his position, recalled, demoted

facts.fact: BLUEBELL 与 MUCHADOO 数月后退休，在政府承包商处获得体面工作，薪水翻倍以上。
facts.anchor: They both took retirement after a few months, then got pretty decent jobs with government contractors, more than doubling their previous salaries
